kid.look: classic blocky kid: yellow skin, teal hoodie, dark jeans, brown hair, backpack, red scarf after s12

statue.look: giant ice figure, about 3x the kid's height: pale blue translucent ice body, crystal spikes on shoulders and head, glowing cyan eyes when awake

townsfolk.look: five or six classic blocky people in bright plain clothes

locations.park: town park: grass, paths, trees, benches, lamp posts, flower beds, a stone plinth in the middle; summer evening light
locations.street: suburban street to school: road, pavement, small houses with lawns, trees, school at the end

shots.narration: In this town, nobody touches the ice statue in the park.
shots.action: statue frozen on its plinth in a crouching pose; townsfolk stroll on the paths around it
shots.camera: high aerial over the park, slow push-in towards the statue

shots.narration: Because whoever touches it... wakes it up.
shots.camera: low angle close on the statue's face, slow upward tilt

shots.action: townsfolk walk past the plinth giving it a wide berth, one points at it and shakes their head
shots.camera: side tracking shot at waist height following the walkers

shots.action: kid walks in along the path towards the statue, looking around curiously
shots.camera: front medium shot of the kid walking towards camera, slow pull-back

shots.action: kid reaches up and touches the statue's foot
shots.camera: over-the-shoulder close from behind the kid, hand meeting ice

shots.action: snow begins to fall; the kid looks up at the sky
shots.camera: wide low angle from the ground looking up past the kid at the falling snow

shots.action: statue's eyes snap open and glow
shots.camera: extreme close-up on the statue's face, quick punch-in on the blink

shots.action: statue rises from its crouch to full height, snow shaking off; ground shakes
shots.camera: very low angle behind the kid looking up at the statue as it rises, camera shake

shots.action: townsfolk run away in all directions; the kid turns to run and falls flat
shots.camera: wide shot from the side, then the kid falls into the foreground

shots.action: silent beat: the kid on the ground looks up, the statue's shadow falls over them
shots.camera: close-up on the kid's face from above, slow push-in

shots.action: statue kneels and reaches its huge hand down towards the kid
shots.camera: over the kid's shoulder looking up at the descending hand

shots.narration: and gave me back the scarf I lost last winter.
shots.action: the hand opens: a red scarf; the kid takes it and wraps it around their neck, delighted
shots.camera: close on the open hand and scarf, then pull back to both characters

shots.narration: Now it walks me to school every day.
shots.action: the kid walks along the street with the scarf on; the statue walks beside them; light snow
shots.camera: side tracking shot at the kid's height, the statue towering in frame

shots.narration: And in this town, nobody touches me either.
shots.action: the kid stands smugly in front of the school, the statue behind with arms folded; townsfolk keep their distance
shots.camera: front, slightly low, slow push-in on the kid
